text: Android UI after 3.2.0: one-line slim account headings, server-admin chooser per account, drag-reorder accounts, new-list name validation (both clients)

Item 6 (maintainer, after filing): the drawer groups destinations at the top and utilities at the bottom, Material style: Overview, Accounts, Join a list — divider — Settings, Server admin, About. Settings belongs in the bottom group (it is not a destination); About stays last.

Item 6 revised: the split is everyday vs administration, not destination vs utility (Accounts and Join a list are not destinations either). Order: Overview, Join a list — divider — Accounts, Settings, Server admin, About.
Item 6 final: three groups with the same divider between them — Overview | Join a list, Accounts | Settings, Server admin, About.

All six items on main (HEAD 5e9de023) as six cherry-picked commits, full gate green (core 114, app debug 770, web 598). Agent's parity calls kept: the web menu gets the same dividers (Join a list alone in its middle group, no Accounts on the web), and the web no longer substitutes the default currency for a blank one. Drag reorder shared in ui/DragReorder.kt with the category behaviour unchanged; Move up/down stay as accessibility actions.
